title: Red Legend Solid
lines: The overall strength rating of the Red Legend Solid shows it is the strongest Black Widow ever!
The 2000 Abralon® finish gives the Red Legend Solid plenty of traction in the oil.
Our legendary Gas Mask Core creates a strong overall ball motion that never quits.
Juiced is one of our most aggressive covers to date. Combining it with our Gas Mask Core creates one deadly combo.
REACTION Strong Mid-lane with Dangerously Aggressive Backend
BEST LANE CONDITION Medium to Heavy Oil
